doc.title: Carter Benny — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

title: Why film scoring changed and synthesizers
summary: Carter blames changing tastes and self-contained groups for the end of the great film composers and says he used a synthesizer early.

story.theme_name: Jazz musicians in the movies and film scoring
story.community_name: Studio work and jingles: New York session life

blocks.x: Sort of bringing an end to this Hollywood phase of studio writing and arranging, a lot of factors were changing in the film industry and, specifically, the demands for music that began to limit opportunities for studio musicians and for the regular writers and arrangers for films. What sort of changes did you observe that were really bringing to a close this era of the great film score and all these writers that we’ve been mentioning?

Oh, I don’t know. I think it came about with the changes in the tastes of the young people. So many of the films were done with records, you know, a great deal of that, and small groups, as they called, self-contained groups, and they didn’t feel that they had the need for the Bernie Hermans [phonetic], the Max Donnas [phonetic], the David Rackses, the Hank Mancinis. Of course, Hank has always been very busy and much sought after. But there was a change that came about, but I wouldn’t know how to explain it too well.
What about the advent of electronic instruments like synthesizers and . . .
Well, of course, much of that, as we well know, a score can be done with just one musician, you know. But I don’t know too much about that end of it.
You did, on occasion, use a synthesizer in your writing.
Well, in the very early days, yes.
The early days of the synthesizers, right?
No, not in my early days.
Because then you’d be even more ahead of your time than I thought.
How did you find it as a creative tool? Obviously you weren’t completely opposed to it, since you did use it.
No. No, I’m still not opposed to it. I think a lot of things are happening with the synthesizers and what is it, the drum machines. A lot of good effects are brought about.
What circumstances to you find it a favorable tool to use that you might . . .
I guess it can be used in any circumstance, but I don’t know. I don’t use them.
